title: MG1937/ASC
title_zh: Droid ASC: R8编译优化作为解编译的基本要素

paragraphs.en: ASC is a super FAST and lightweight Android decompiler designed for Agents/Mobile Researchers.
paragraphs.zh: ASC 是一款专为智能体/移动研究人员设计的超快速、轻量级 Android 反编译器。

paragraphs.en: Rust version: This project has been rewritten 1:1 in Rust as rust_ASC . The Rust version is 10× faster and supports full APK decompilation: with 16 threads, it decompiles a 383 MB APK in just 4 seconds.
paragraphs.zh: Rust 版本：本项目已用 Rust 1:1 重写为 rust_ASC。 Rust 版本速度提升 10 倍，并支持完整的 APK 反编译：使用 16 线程，仅需 4 秒即可反编译一个 383 MB 的 APK。

sents.en: Rust version: This project has been rewritten 1:1 in Rust as rust_ASC .
sents.zh: Rust 版本：本项目已用 Rust 1:1 重写为 rust_ASC。

sents.en: The Rust version is 10× faster and supports full APK decompilation: with 16 threads, it decompiles a 383 MB APK in just 4 seconds.
sents.zh: Rust 版本速度提升 10 倍，并支持完整的 APK 反编译：使用 16 线程，仅需 4 秒即可反编译一个 383 MB 的 APK。

paragraphs.en: If your workflow is written in Python, you can continue integrating with this project; it remains the fastest Python Android decompiler available. If you only need a binary, please use rust_ASC .
paragraphs.zh: 如果你的工作流是用 Python 编写的，你可以继续与本项目集成；它仍然是可用的最快的 Python Android 反编译器。 如果你只需要一个二进制文件，请使用 rust_ASC。

sents.en: If your workflow is written in Python, you can continue integrating with this project; it remains the fastest Python Android decompiler available.
sents.zh: 如果你的工作流是用 Python 编写的，你可以继续与本项目集成；它仍然是可用的最快的 Python Android 反编译器。

sents.en: If you only need a binary, please use rust_ASC .
sents.zh: 如果你只需要一个二进制文件，请使用 rust_ASC。

paragraphs.en: ASC and rust_ASC will be maintained in parallel, so users can choose the integration style that best fits their workflow.
paragraphs.zh: ASC 和 rust_ASC 将并行维护，因此用户可以选择最适合其工作流程的集成风格。

paragraphs.zh: https://blackhat.com/europe/arsenal/schedule/index.html#droid-asc-r8-compiler-optimization-as-a-decompiler-primitive-54834

paragraphs.en: When decompiling massive Android APKs, the standard procedure is to wait. We wait for tools to eat gigabytes of RAM, fully inflate the artifacts, and spend tens of minutes building heavy global indexes and cross references... All of this is just to guarantee fast code searches later, but here is the contradiction. A compiled artifact is already highly structured, modern decompilers never utilize this, they waste massive amounts of time and memory reconstructing a bloated database of code relationships over already structured data. This engineering approach defies common sense. When I can directly extract any code relationship from the APK in milliseconds, does this preprocessing still hold any value?
paragraphs.zh: 在反编译海量 Android APK 时，标准流程就是等待。 我们等待工具吃掉数 GB 的内存，完全展开产物，并花费几十分钟构建庞大的全局索引和交叉引用…… 这一切只是为了保证之后的代码搜索更快，但这里存在一个矛盾。 编译产物本身已经是高度结构化的，现代反编译器却从不利用这一点，它们浪费大量时间和内存，在已经结构化的数据之上重建一个臃肿的代码关系数据库。 这种工程做法违背了常识。 当我能在几毫秒内直接从 APK 中提取任意代码关系时，这种预处理还有存在的价值吗？

sents.en: When decompiling massive Android APKs, the standard procedure is to wait.
sents.zh: 在反编译海量 Android APK 时，标准流程就是等待。

sents.en: We wait for tools to eat gigabytes of RAM, fully inflate the artifacts, and spend tens of minutes building heavy global indexes and cross references...
sents.zh: 我们等待工具吃掉数 GB 的内存，完全展开产物，并花费几十分钟构建庞大的全局索引和交叉引用……

sents.en: All of this is just to guarantee fast code searches later, but here is the contradiction.
sents.zh: 这一切只是为了保证之后的代码搜索更快，但这里存在一个矛盾。

sents.en: A compiled artifact is already highly structured, modern decompilers never utilize this, they waste massive amounts of time and memory reconstructing a bloated database of code relationships over already structured data.
sents.zh: 编译产物本身已经是高度结构化的，现代反编译器却从不利用这一点，它们浪费大量时间和内存，在已经结构化的数据之上重建一个臃肿的代码关系数据库。

sents.en: This engineering approach defies common sense.
sents.zh: 这种工程做法违背了常识。

sents.en: When I can directly extract any code relationship from the APK in milliseconds, does this preprocessing still hold any value?
sents.zh: 当我能在几毫秒内直接从 APK 中提取任意代码关系时，这种预处理还有存在的价值吗？

paragraphs.en: Instead of forcing decompilers into heavy preprocessing, we choose to query the compiled artifact directly as a database. We built a stateless, zero-overhead engine that extracts and searches code on demand in milliseconds. In this briefing, we will explore the underlying engineering required to bypass traditional bottlenecks. We will demonstrate how to abandon full inflate by probing directly within the Deflate bitstream, building dense Huffman lookup tables to extract core metadata without touching irrelevant data blocks. Furthermore, we will explain optimization details of the R8 compiler, especially how deterministic constant relocation and instruction deduplication leave behind highly concentrated physical layouts, we weaponize this compiler behavior to execute lightning-fast cross DEX code searches. To map these raw bytecode offsets back to methods, we engineered an O(1) instruction locating primitive, achieving constant-time method resolution without building heavy mapping tables. Finally, upon hitting a target, Droid ASC extracts only the specific bytecodes and its dependencies, dynamically reconstructing a minimal and self consistent DEX entirely in memory for instant decompilation.
paragraphs.zh: 我们没有强迫反编译器进行繁重的前置处理，而是选择直接把编译产物当作数据库来查询。 我们构建了一个无状态、零开销的引擎，可以在毫秒级内按需提取和搜索代码。 在本次简报中，我们将探讨绕过传统瓶颈所需的底层工程实践。 我们将演示如何放弃完整的解压流程，直接在 Deflate 比特流中进行探测，构建稠密的 Huffman 查找表来提取核心元数据，而无需触碰无关的数据块。 此外，我们将解释 R8 编译器的优化细节，尤其是确定性的常量重定位和指令去重如何留下高度集中的物理布局；我们利用这一编译器行为来执行闪电般的跨 DEX 代码搜索。 为了把这些原始字节码偏移映射回方法，我们设计了一个 O(1) 的指令定位原语，无需构建庞大的映射表即可实现常数时间的方法解析。 最后，当命中目标时，Droid ASC 只提取特定的字节码及其依赖项，完全在内存中动态重建一个最小且自洽的 DEX，用于即时反编译。

sents.en: Instead of forcing decompilers into heavy preprocessing, we choose to query the compiled artifact directly as a database.
sents.zh: 我们没有强迫反编译器进行繁重的前置处理，而是选择直接把编译产物当作数据库来查询。

sents.en: We built a stateless, zero-overhead engine that extracts and searches code on demand in milliseconds.
sents.zh: 我们构建了一个无状态、零开销的引擎，可以在毫秒级内按需提取和搜索代码。

sents.en: In this briefing, we will explore the underlying engineering required to bypass traditional bottlenecks.
sents.zh: 在本次简报中，我们将探讨绕过传统瓶颈所需的底层工程实践。

sents.en: We will demonstrate how to abandon full inflate by probing directly within the Deflate bitstream, building dense Huffman lookup tables to extract core metadata without touching irrelevant data blocks.
sents.zh: 我们将演示如何放弃完整的解压流程，直接在 Deflate 比特流中进行探测，构建稠密的 Huffman 查找表来提取核心元数据，而无需触碰无关的数据块。

sents.en: Furthermore, we will explain optimization details of the R8 compiler, especially how deterministic constant relocation and instruction deduplication leave behind highly concentrated physical layouts, we weaponize this compiler behavior to execute lightning-fast cross DEX code searches.
sents.zh: 此外，我们将解释 R8 编译器的优化细节，尤其是确定性的常量重定位和指令去重如何留下高度集中的物理布局；我们利用这一编译器行为来执行闪电般的跨 DEX 代码搜索。

sents.en: To map these raw bytecode offsets back to methods, we engineered an O(1) instruction locating primitive, achieving constant-time method resolution without building heavy mapping tables.
sents.zh: 为了把这些原始字节码偏移映射回方法，我们设计了一个 O(1) 的指令定位原语，无需构建庞大的映射表即可实现常数时间的方法解析。

sents.en: Finally, upon hitting a target, Droid ASC extracts only the specific bytecodes and its dependencies, dynamically reconstructing a minimal and self consistent DEX entirely in memory for instant decompilation.
sents.zh: 最后，当命中目标时，Droid ASC 只提取特定的字节码及其依赖项，完全在内存中动态重建一个最小且自洽的 DEX，用于即时反编译。

paragraphs.en: We will demonstrate this architecture live against a 352MB commercial APK. Droid ASC executes global cross reference searches in 1.79 seconds and decompiles target classes in 177 milliseconds using only 141MB of RAM. By treating the artifact as a read only database and operating with zero preprocessing, we return the decompiler to its core essence. It is no longer a bloated indexing tool, but a lightning fast, on demand decompilation engine that fundamentally redefines how we analyze compiled code.
paragraphs.zh: 我们将在现场对一个 352MB 的商业 APK 演示这一架构。 Droid ASC 仅使用 141MB 内存，就能在 1.79 秒内执行全局交叉引用搜索，并在 177 毫秒内反编译目标类。 通过将产物视为只读数据库并以零预处理方式运行，我们让反编译器回归其核心本质。 它不再是一个臃肿的索引工具，而是一个闪电般快速的按需反编译引擎，从根本上重新定义了我们分析编译代码的方式。

sents.en: We will demonstrate this architecture live against a 352MB commercial APK.
sents.zh: 我们将在现场对一个 352MB 的商业 APK 演示这一架构。

sents.en: Droid ASC executes global cross reference searches in 1.79 seconds and decompiles target classes in 177 milliseconds using only 141MB of RAM.
sents.zh: Droid ASC 仅使用 141MB 内存，就能在 1.79 秒内执行全局交叉引用搜索，并在 177 毫秒内反编译目标类。

sents.en: By treating the artifact as a read only database and operating with zero preprocessing, we return the decompiler to its core essence.
sents.zh: 通过将产物视为只读数据库并以零预处理方式运行，我们让反编译器回归其核心本质。

sents.en: It is no longer a bloated indexing tool, but a lightning fast, on demand decompilation engine that fundamentally redefines how we analyze compiled code.
sents.zh: 它不再是一个臃肿的索引工具，而是一个闪电般快速的按需反编译引擎，从根本上重新定义了我们分析编译代码的方式。

paragraphs.en: Raw absolute values, measured with 10 threads across four APK targets of increasing size:
paragraphs.zh: 原始绝对值，使用 10 个线程在四个大小递增的 APK 目标上测量得到：

paragraphs.en: ASC is 62x to 302x faster than JADX for global string xref search.
paragraphs.zh: ASC 在全局字符串交叉引用搜索方面比 JADX 快 62 倍到 302 倍。

paragraphs.en: ASC is 38x to 304x faster than JADX for single-class decompile.
paragraphs.zh: ASC 在单类反编译方面比 JADX 快 38 倍到 304 倍。

paragraphs.en: ASC uses 28x to 125x less memory than JADX for CLI operation.
paragraphs.zh: ASC 在命令行操作时使用的内存比 JADX 少 28 到 125 倍。

paragraphs.en: ASC stays fully in memory with zero disk cache, while JADX writes up to 322MB.
paragraphs.zh: ASC 完全保留在内存中，零磁盘缓存，而 JADX 最多写入 322MB。

paragraphs.en: Note: JADX runs out of memory on the largest target (Lark) during the global search (~49% searched), while ASC completes every target.
paragraphs.zh: 注意：在对最大目标（Lark）进行全局搜索时，JADX 在搜索约 49% 时内存耗尽，而 ASC 则完成了所有目标。

paragraphs.en: As the benchmark shows, ASC is 62x faster than JADX on ~50MB APKs, and 302x faster on ~300MB APKs, with a tiny memory footprint. Agents can pair with ASC to analyze dozens or even hundreds of APKs at once, even on weak machines. The JADX MCP has a harder time here: JADX alone uses several GB just to preload, which makes switching between hundreds of APKs impractical.
paragraphs.zh: 正如基准测试所示，在约 50MB 的 APK 上，ASC 比 JADX 快 62 倍，在约 300MB 的 APK 上快 302 倍，且内存占用极小。 智能体可以与 ASC 配合，一次性分析数十个甚至数百个 APK，即使是在性能较弱的机器上也是如此。 JADX MCP 在这方面就比较吃力：仅 JADX 本身预加载就需要数 GB 内存，这使得在数百个 APK 之间切换变得不切实际。

sents.en: After installation, the droidasc CLI command is available globally:
sents.zh: 安装完成后，droidasc CLI 命令即可全局使用：

paragraphs.en: usage: droidasc [-h] {getclass,disassemble,listclass,getmanifest,findrefs} ... ASC tooling entry (v0.1.2.post1). positional arguments: {getclass,disassemble,listclass,getmanifest,findrefs} getclass Locate the target class in APK, extract one DEX in memory, then decompile. disassemble Extract a class, rebuild a small DEX, then disassemble it with dadguard. listclass List classes across all DEX entries; use --prefix to filter by package/class prefix. getmanifest Decode AndroidManifest.xml from APK and print it as XML. findrefs Find code references for string/type/method/field across all DEX entries in APK. options: -h, --help show this help message and exit examples: droidasc app.apk --gui droidasc getclass app.apk Lcom/poc/Main; -o Main.java droidasc getclass app.apk com.poc.Main --threads 16 droidasc disassemble app.apk Lcom/poc/Main; -o Main.smali droidasc disassemble app.apk com.poc.Main --debug droidasc disassemble app.apk com.poc.Main --debuginfo droidasc disassemble app.apk com.poc.Main --method 'run(I)V' droidasc listclass app.apk droidasc listclass app.apk -o classes.txt droidasc listclass app.apk --prefix com.poc droidasc getmanifest app.apk droidasc getmanifest app.apk -o AndroidManifest.xml droidasc findrefs app.apk string token -o string_refs.txt droidasc findrefs app.apk type com.poc.Main droidasc findrefs app.apk method onCreate --class com.poc.Main droidasc findrefs app.apk method notify --class MainActivity --fuzzy-class -o method_refs.txt droidasc findrefs app.apk field apiKey -o field_refs.txt droidasc findrefs app.apk extends java.lang.Object droidasc findrefs app.apk extends android.app.Activity -o subclasses.txt droidasc findrefs app.apk impl android.os.IInterface -o impls.txt -V / --version prints the installed package version.
paragraphs.zh: 用法：droidasc [-h] {getclass,disassemble,listclass,getmanifest,findrefs} ... ASC 工具入口（v0.1.2.post1）。位置参数：{getclass,disassemble,listclass,getmanifest,findrefs} getclass 在 APK 中定位目标类，在内存中提取一个 DEX，然后反编译。disassemble 提取一个类，重建一个小型 DEX，然后用 dadguard 对其进行反汇编。listclass 列出所有 DEX 条目中的类；使用 --prefix 按包/类前缀过滤。getmanifest 从 APK 中解码 AndroidManifest.xml 并以 XML 形式打印。findrefs 在 APK 的所有 DEX 条目中查找字符串/类型/方法/字段的代码引用。选项：-h, --help 显示此帮助消息并退出。示例：droidasc app.apk --gui droidasc getclass app.apk Lcom/poc/Main; -o Main.java droidasc getclass app.apk com.poc.Main --threads 16 droidasc disassemble app.apk Lcom/poc/Main; -o Main.smali droidasc disassemble app.apk com.poc.Main --debug droidasc disassemble app.apk com.poc.Main --debuginfo droidasc disassemble app.apk com.poc.Main --method 'run(I)V' droidasc listclass app.apk droidasc listclass app.apk -o classes.txt droidasc listclass app.apk --prefix com.poc droidasc getmanifest app.apk droidasc getmanifest app.apk -o AndroidManifest.xml droidasc findrefs app.apk string token -o string_refs.txt droidasc findrefs app.apk type com.poc.Main droidasc findrefs app.apk method onCreate --class com.poc.Main droidasc findrefs app.apk method notify --class MainActivity --fuzzy-class -o method_refs.txt droidasc findrefs app.apk field apiKey -o field_refs.txt droidasc findrefs app.apk extends java.lang.Object droidasc findrefs app.apk extends android.app.Activity -o subclasses.txt droidasc findrefs app.apk impl android.os.IInterface -o impls.txt -V / --version 显示已安装的软件包版本。

paragraphs.en: findrefs searches for code references (string/type/method/field) across all DEX entries; -o writes results to the selected file instead of stdout, and --threads N controls the worker pool. extends / impl locate classes that extend a target class or implement a target interface, respectively.
paragraphs.zh: findrefs 会在所有 DEX 条目中搜索代码引用（字符串/类型/方法/字段）；-o 将结果写入所选文件而非标准输出，--threads N 控制工作线程池。extends / impl 分别用于定位继承目标类或实现目标接口的类。

paragraphs.en: listclass prints Dalvik class descriptors in APK/DEX definition order, one per line. With -o , output is written to the selected file instead of stdout. --prefix com.poc filters by Lcom/poc ; an already normalized prefix such as Lcom/poc is kept unchanged.
paragraphs.zh: listclass 按 APK/DEX 中的定义顺序逐行打印 Dalvik 类描述符，每行一个。 使用 -o 时，输出会写入所选文件而不是标准输出。--prefix com.poc 按 Lcom/poc 进行过滤；已规范化的前缀（如 Lcom/poc）会保持不变。

sents.en: listclass prints Dalvik class descriptors in APK/DEX definition order, one per line.
sents.zh: listclass 按 APK/DEX 中的定义顺序逐行打印 Dalvik 类描述符，每行一个。

sents.en: With -o , output is written to the selected file instead of stdout. --prefix com.poc filters by Lcom/poc ; an already normalized prefix such as Lcom/poc is kept unchanged.
sents.zh: 使用 -o 时，输出会写入所选文件而不是标准输出。--prefix com.poc 按 Lcom/poc 进行过滤；已规范化的前缀（如 Lcom/poc）会保持不变。

paragraphs.en: disassemble accepts the same dotted or Dalvik class formats as getclass . It extracts the target class from the APK, rebuilds a small DEX in memory, and disassembles the rebuilt DEX with dadguard . --debug enables timing output and instruction offset comments; --debuginfo enables DEX .line and local variable directives. --method 'run(I)V' restricts output to one exact method signature; a bare method name is rejected. All commands that support -o write to stdout when -o is omitted.
paragraphs.zh: disassemble 支持与 getclass 相同的点分格式或 Dalvik 类名格式。 它会从 APK 中提取目标类，在内存中重建一个小型 DEX，然后使用 dadguard 反汇编重建的 DEX。--debug 启用计时输出和指令偏移注释；--debuginfo 启用 DEX .line 和局部变量指令。--method 'run(I)V' 将输出限制为一个精确的方法签名；仅给出方法名（不带签名）会被拒绝。 所有支持 -o 的命令在省略 -o 时都会写入标准输出。

paragraphs.en: You can also use python main.py as before — it delegates to the same entry point.
paragraphs.zh: 你也可以像之前一样使用 python main.py —— 它会委托给同一个入口点。

paragraphs.en: Thank you to all sponsors for your support!
paragraphs.zh: 感谢所有赞助商的支持！

paragraphs.en: ASC is built with the hope that it can genuinely help everyone improve their reverse engineering workflow — from speeding up the tedious parts to making the impossible feel routine.
paragraphs.zh: ASC 的构建初衷是希望它能真正帮助每个人改进自己的逆向工程工作流程——从加快繁琐的部分，到让不可能的事情变得习以为常。

paragraphs.en: Thanks to the Androguard project for providing the Android reverse-engineering and DEX analysis foundation used by Droid ASC.
paragraphs.zh: 感谢 Androguard 项目为 Droid ASC 所使用的 Android 逆向工程与 DEX 分析提供了基础。
